title: Integration-test helpers build SQL by raw string concatenation of row identifiers
evidence:
line 127: "    "SELECT status::text FROM reference_call WHERE id = '" <> row_id <> "'","
lines 98-99: "       $1::uuid, 'landlord_ref', $2::reference_call_status, " <> int.to_string(
      attempt_count,
line 144: "    "SELECT (next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL)::text FROM reference_call WHERE id = '"
      <> row_id
      <> "'","
detail: Test-only, and every interpolated value is server-generated (row_id from RETURNING id::text, attempt_count a literal), so not exploitable as written — but the raw-concat pattern is the exact injection surface flagged, and becomes exploitable the moment any helper is reused with untrusted input.
recommended_fix: Parameterise the row lookups ($1::uuid) and the INSERT's attempt_count, as rearm_due already does; keep string concatenation out of SQL even in tests.
